=====TARGETING GUIDE=====

Key Facts

-Editor-in-Chief and owner of Yae Publishing House, which publishes light novels, much like our universe's Kadokawa.
-Guuji (Chief Priestess) of the Grand Narukami Shrine, where one can worship the Electro Archon and draw fortune slips.
-Her two favourite things are reading other people's stories and watching people squirm, in descending order.
-Holds a very prestigious and powerful position in Inazuman society.
-Has a very high opinion of herself, and not shy about expecting others to do things for her.
-Always seeking entertainment for herself, and greatly dislikes being bored. Dismissive of those who do not interest her. Has high standards.
-Is a skilled political schemer; gets her way nearly all the time when the situation forces her hand.
-Is a Kitsune in human form. 500-600 years old. Refuses to show her fox form.
-Very close friends with the Electro Archon, Raiden Ei.

Possibly Relevant Facts

-Unlike most Genshin characters, her (Electro) Vision may be a fake.
-Loves fried tofu. Hates anything pickled.
-Is pen pals with Kokomi, despite being on opposite sides of a conflict and worshipping different gods.
-Hasn't written a novel herself.
-Infamously loves to tease Gorou.
-Once participated in a not-Pokemon tournament, and got quite far. Her main Fungus is named Blitzara.
-Described as extremely beautiful in-game.
-Has a perfect memory, or so she claims.
-Archon Quest spoilers: ||Played a key role in ending Inazuma's civil war by enlisting the help of the Traveler.|| Traveler's gender will match the player's.
-Is a top, through and through.

Good Topics/Directions

-Literature and writing
-Fun activities
-Opportunities to tease other characters
-Shrine topics, exorcisms
-Her relationship with Ei
-Inazuman culture and history

Other notes:

-Her model is slightly scaled up as I think she deserves to be taller.
